descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark X66 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard White Cheese (Side-Printed PBT Keycaps / Tri-Mode 2.4GHz, Bluetooth & Wired / Gasket Mounted Structure / Hot-Swappable Switches / RGB Backlight / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Experience superior typing acoustics and clean aesthetic style with the Attack Shark X66 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard in White Cheese colorway, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year store warranty. Featuring durable side-printed PBT keycaps for a sleek legend-free top look, a cushioned Gasket Mounted structure for ultra-smooth typing feedback, hot-swappable switch sockets, and versatile tri-mode wireless connectivity (2.4GHz, Bluetooth, USB-C), the X66 is crafted for seamless gaming and productivity setups.
